svg.text: Smart Class Management System — UML Class Diagram
Thusitha Institute · Group IIT 03 · Reconciled against backend codebase
Note — "Report" class removed from this diagram
Earlier UML drafts included a Report class with no backing
database table. Reporting is implemented as read-only query
endpoints over existing tables, not a persisted entity.
All classes shown are implemented as procedural
controller functions in Express.js (no OOP class
instances) operating on PostgreSQL tables matching
these class names. Attributes map to table columns;
methods map to exported controller/service functions.
reconciled into diagram after codebase audit.
